{"status": "success", "summary": "Implemented `slots` and `overlaps` in units/schedule/schedule.py so the frozen test_schedule.py passes. Test file was not modified (only schedule.py written).

Acceptance command run (from workspace root, then into the unit):
  cd units/schedule && python3 -m pytest -q
Verbatim output:
  ..                                                                       [100%]
  2 passed in 0.04s
  EXIT=0

Files changed: units/schedule/schedule.py (sha256 22844016be3f2ee68902554c6dce0547aa51664a25b8bf3ab6271bdfe13122ad). test_schedule.py untouched (sha256 d0eac968ccaa16dd71ca63f9a264f9aca424a03de2e94c6d77e607d7a5585b14).

Implementation semantics:
- slots(ranges, minutes): sorts by start, then merges consecutive segments when `next_lo - prev_hi < minutes`, keeping max(prev_hi, next_hi). Returns list of (lo, hi) tuples in ascending start order.
- overlaps(a, b): strict intersection `a_lo < b_hi and b_lo < a_hi`, returns a real bool.

Edge-case semantics verified with an ad-hoc (non-test) script:
- empty input -> [] (slots([], 30) == []).
- gap == minutes -> NOT merged: slots([(0,10),(20,30)], 10) == [(0,10),(20,30)]. (This is the key boundary the test pins: 90->120 with minutes=30 stays split.)
- gap < minutes -> merged: slots([(0,10),(19,30)], 10) == [(0,30)]; gap > minutes -> split: [(0,10),(21,30)].
- touching endpoints -> not an overlap: overlaps((0,10),(10,20)) is False; overlaps((0,10),(5,20)) is True (bool, passes `is True`).
- unsorted input -> normalized: slots([(120,150),(30,90),(0,60)], 30) == [(0,90),(120,150)].
- nested/contained input -> merged preserving outer extent: slots([(0,100),(10,20),(30,40)], 5) == [(0,100)] (max-hi logic prevents shrinking).", "evidence": ["cd units/schedule && python3 -m pytest -q -> '..  [100%]  2 passed in 0.04s' EXIT=0", "sha256 schedule.py 22844016be3f2ee68902554c6dce0547aa51664a25b8bf3ab6271bdfe13122ad; test_schedule.py d0eac968ccaa16dd71ca63f9a264f9aca424a03de2e94c6d77e607d7a5585b14 (unchanged)", "edge probe: empty->[], gap==minutes->[(0,10),(20,30)], unsorted->[(0,90),(120,150)], nested->[(0,100)], touching->False"]}
